findings.title: 领取预过滤仍应用当前配置，破坏持久讨论请求的冻结策略
findings.requirement: FD-019: claim, guidance and start must share the frozen discussion backend policy
findings.evidence: TaskClaimService exempts only managed recommendations from current aiProfiles.canRun; goal claims subsequently apply persisted frozen profiles. After a profile runtime is removed on restart, neither the old frozen runtime nor the newly configured runtime can claim an existing queued goal request.
findings.required_change: Exempt managed goal-discussion requests from the generic current-profile prefilter and retain GoalTaskPolicy frozen admission; leave ordinary task checks unchanged.
